title: Thai learning and everyday translation
intro: Start with existing tools. Thai lessons and quick translation serve different needs.
learnText: Explore Thai lessons with Thai and Myanmar instruction on LearnBig. Videos use internet data.
translateText: Open Google Translate for everyday words and phrases. Select your languages and use Listen when available.
external: These tools open outside Lift. Their own privacy terms apply. Lift sends none of your plan, questions or documents automatically.
limits: Machine translation can be wrong. Confirm important dates, amounts and instructions with a trusted person.
status: External resources; no Lift partnership or service availability is guaranteed.
ydcText: YDC remains our general learning platform. Life & Learning in Thailand is a planned optional collection. For Phase 1, use the external learning links here; our own Thai audio lessons are not available yet.
